If your heart rate drops out or the Pulse keeps disconnecting, wet the electrode pads again and tighten the strap. Keep the device it's paired with within 2 meters. Pair the Pulse through the Coach app, not through your phone's Bluetooth settings. Put on the strap, open the Coach app, and go to Devices > Add device > Pulse. If the Pulse doesn't appear, make sure it isn't already connected to your Row, because the Pulse connects to one device at a time.

If you see two charges from BeefCake Coach, one of them may be a temporary authorization hold from your bank, which usually disappears within 3 to 5 business days. If both charges are still there after 5 business days, contact BeefCake Support with the dates and amounts of both charges so we can look into it.

[BeefCake Pulse manual > Wearing the Pulse]
The BeefCake Pulse is a chest strap heart-rate monitor. Wet the two electrode pads on the back of the strap with water, then wear the strap just below your chest muscles with the BeefCake logo facing out. Tighten it so it stays in place without being uncomfortable.

[BeefCake Bell manual > Battery and charging]
The Bell has a rechargeable battery that charges over USB-C through the port under the handle. A full charge takes about 2 hours and lasts about 30 workouts. The battery drains faster if the Bell stays connected to the app when you're not using it. Put the Bell back in its cradle after a workout and it will go to sleep after 5 minutes.
